heading: Welcome to Interstellar CMS

sections.text: A modern, Git-driven CMS built for Astro and Cloudflare with official Google Material Design 3 theme.
sections.reassurance: Easily edit pages, blocks, and design tokens directly in your browser with real-time preview.

items.title: 1. Create & Edit
items.text: Edit content, structured data, and layouts visually or with Markdown in the browser.

items.title: 2. Live 1:1 Preview
items.text: Preview your changes instantly rendered with the exact same Material 3 design tokens.

items.title: 3. Single Atomic Commit
items.text: Every save is an atomic Git commit directly to your GitHub repository without a database.

seoDescription: The Git-backed, edge-native CMS for Astro with official Google Material Design 3 theme system.
